description: Mask low-complexity regions in a DNA sequence with the symmetric DUST algorithm (SDUST; Morgulis et al. 2006, identical to lh3/sdust). N and other IUPAC codes are accepted; each maximal A/C/G/T run is scanned independently (sdust's documented contract: "N effectively breaks input into pieces of independent sequences"; sdust's code itself carries its scoring window across N). Optional dustmasker linker merge and soft (lower-case) masking.

sequence.description: The DNA sequence to mask (A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N; case-insensitive)

threshold.description: DUST threshold above which to mask (default: 2.0)

linker.description: dustmasker linker: merge masked intervals separated by fewer than linker unmasked bases (1-32, default: 1 = sdust/dustmasker default)

softMask.description: Soft-mask: lower-case masked bases, upper-case the rest (dustmasker -outfmt fasta). Default: false

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Window size must be at least 1
Invalid DNA sequence (A/C/G/T and IUPAC codes only)
